HITES Manager Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 21 Chief Manager, Senior Operations Manager, and Operations Manager Posts - Complete Details

The HLL Infra Tech Services (HITES) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 21 Chief Manager, Senior Operations Manager, and Operations Manager. Candidates with B.Tech/B.E, M.E/M.Tech Can Apply Online. The online application opens on 19-09-2026, and closes on 10-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through HITES website, hllhites.com.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 19 September 2026
  • Notification Date : 19 September 2026
  • Opening Date of Online Application : 19 September 2026
  • Closing Date of Online Application : 10 October 2026, till 18:00 hours
  • Cut-off Date for Age & Experience : 1 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Posts : Chief Manager, Senior Operations Manager, and Operations Manager – across Design (Structural, HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, BME, Quantity Surveying) and Execution (Civil, MEP) disciplines
  • Total Posts : 21
  • Posting : Any HITES office/project site across India (and possibly overseas locations), at Management’s discretion; candidates may be posted to other relevant disciplines as required
  • Sr. Operations Manager (Structural) : M.E./M.Tech (Structural), Full Time
  • Senior Operations Manager (Structural, HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing) : 45 years

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
